task: Implement generate_report for the finance system without using analytics report logic.

candidate_memories.content: Finance system generate_report computes GL account balances and produces a PDF ledger output.
Finance report generation requires strict decimal precision and currency formatting rules.
Finance reports are audit artifacts; they must be immutable once generated and stored with a hash.
When generate_report spans finance and analytics, confirm the precision and immutability requirements.
Analytics: generate_report queries aggregate event counts and returns a JSON dashboard payload.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: analytics report logic lacks the decimal precision and audit immutability required

candidate_memories.content: Old tooling note says a shared generate_report interface would reduce duplication across teams.
